title: The named discrete scalar objectives have one shape-uniform small-coupling Legendre expansion

factorization.seed_scope: symmetric Rademacher and the K1688 sixth-cumulant-canceling three-point seed
factorization.global_branch: For one seed-only r_0>0, the unique global minimizer for 0<=r<=r_0 solves j_X'(q)=r.

uniform_expansion.reason: ell_g/tau_g is bounded on the compactified rectangle space, so r=4g ell_g/tau_g is O(g) uniformly.

scope_guard: Uniformity covers moving K1683 rectangles for the two named discrete seeds near zero coupling; it does not classify every seed or finite interpolation strength.
